post.title: Artwork for a book finding / thrifting app [Hiring] Book Spotter
post.body:
Budget:

$200-$350

Overview:

Need a designer to create original vector art and PNG files for Book Spotter app branding assets, including multiple app icon sizes, a favicon range, and a website logo for the app. [link]

Story & Expectations:

I built an app that started out with treasure hunts with my wife! We loving going to thrift stores and estate sales and one of the things we're always looking for are books that we love. I've been building software for years and it occurred to me, maybe my phone can make spotting books better/faster/more efficient. So I built Book Spotter! And we have found so many books with it.

I keep going back to the idea of using Treasure Island in the branding since it's public domain and thrifting, hunting for books is like a treasure hunt. I'm open to other creative ideas though.

Deliverables

Vectorized art and PNG files for app icons at 1024x1024, 512×512, and 1024×500

A favicon sized for use from 48x48 down to 16x16

A website logo for the Book Spotter app

All assets exported to Adobe Illustrator format (.ai) and PSD photoshop files (the tools you use are up to you as long as it can go to Illustrator and photoshop)

Rights: On final payment, exclusive commercial rights go to me.

Revisions & timeline: Please include how many concept directions and revision rounds you offer, and your estimated turnaround :)
